name: matt kim
tagline: building things people would actually use.
headline: full-stack and agentic engineer.
bio: i started with a python text adventure in middle school. that curiosity grew into state-level robotics, hackathons, and a habit of learning whatever a problem needs to get it shipped.
san francisco / ucsb, studying stats & data science and economics. i like turning frontier models into products that are fast, reliable, and actually useful.
